column1: # External tools the fleet calls: bin/*, its tests (bin/tests, dashboard/tests, hooks tests) and the motion-video + gamedev skill scripts. install.sh checks them; bin/tests/deps-manifest.test.sh keeps the list complete.
# apt: Ubuntu package(s) to install, `-` when not from the Ubuntu archive (install hint in the `# hint` lines below).
# level: required stops install.sh; advisory only disables the verbs; test is needed by the test suite; optional:media (/motion-video) and
# optional:gamedev (/gamedev) only by those skills. A tool used in several places sits in the strongest: required > advisory > test > optional.
# min (optional 5th field, `>= N`): lowest major version; install.sh flags an older one; install-fresh.sh --suite puts the latest N.x node in the box.
# The test-also line names tools the suite needs whose row sits at a stronger level; `install.sh --test-deps` installs them with level test.
# test-also: bwrap tmux column curl time node npm sudo logrotate python3:evdev python3:PIL python3:markdown python3:numpy unzip run-clang-tidy
# gamedev-cpp (apt packages `install.sh --gamedev` adds, then vcpkg and the flip venv: the C++ template build and its run on lavapipe):

# gamedev-cpp: cmake ninja-build gcc g++ clang mold ccache glslang-tools spirv-tools binutils git curl zip unzip tar pkg-config weston libegl-mesa0 libgl1-mesa-dri mesa-vulkan-drivers vulkan-validationlayers python3-venv python3-dev
# hint node npx npm: node >= 22.15 (Ubuntu 24.04 apt has 18: use nvm or NodeSource); this box runs node 24 from nvm.
# hint godot: Godot 4.7.2 from godotengine.org into ~/opt/gamedev, linked as ~/.local/bin/godot (/gamedev).
# hint gltfpack: upstream 1.3 with BasisU in ~/opt/gamedev/gltfpack-1.3 (apt gltfpack lacks -tc).
# hint renderdoccmd: RenderDoc 1.46 tarball into ~/opt/gamedev, linked into ~/.local/bin.
# hint gltf_validator ktx: glTF-Validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 and KTX-Software 4.4.2 release tarballs into ~/opt/gamedev (sha256 in ~/opt/gamedev/dl/SHA256-LOG.txt), linked into ~/.local/bin (T560).
# hint flip: pip flip-evaluator 1.7 in ~/opt/gamedev/flip-venv (not on PATH; cpp-ci reads CPPCI_FLIP or that venv), used by the cpp-ci golden stage (T593).
# hint tracy-capture tracy-csvexport: built from Tracy 0.14.1 (capture + csvexport) into ~/opt/gamedev, linked into ~/.local/bin (T546).
# hint manim lizard: pipx install manim / pipx install lizard.
# hint mv-otio: uv venv -p 3.12 ~/.local/opt/mv-otio + opentimelineio 0.18.1, otio-kdenlive-adapter 0.0.3, otio-fcpx-xml-adapter 1.0.0 (mv-otio prints the line; T646).

# hint npm:playwright-core playwright:chromium-headless-shell: `npm install -g playwright-core`, then `playwright-core install --with-deps chromium-headless-shell` (install-fresh.sh --suite does both).
# hint claude eye body-sandbox tailscale: the agent CLI, The Dark Eye repo, tailscale.com/install.sh.
# hint ruff uv: uv from astral.sh/uv/install.sh into ~/.local/bin; then uv tool install ruff (user scope, ~/.local/bin/ruff; T1129).
